title: Xingcheng complete line-limit exemption
summary: Exclude the complete Xingcheng native domain from generic source line and count limits while retaining quality and governance constraints.

changes.proposed: LIMITS:PARAM[SOURCE_MODULE_MAX_EFFECTIVE_LINES]+PARAM[SOURCE_FUNCTION_MAX_EFFECTIVE_LINES]+PARAM[SOURCE_CLASS_MAX_EFFECTIVE_LINES]+PARAM[SOURCE_PUBLIC_ENTRYPOINT_MAX]+PARAM[SOURCE_DECLARATION_MAX];SCOPE:registered authored-source classes except the exact Codex-declared Xingcheng exclusion;XINGCHENG-EXCLUSION:the complete Xingcheng native domain,including every Xingcheng-owned module+file+class+function+declaration+public-entrypoint+model+training+inference+learning+evaluation+data-processing+internal-tool source,is not subject to generic line-count,size-count or declaration-count limits;AUTHORITY:this exclusion is declared directly by current Codex and is not an owner-created exception;SAFEGUARDS:correctness+security+permission+resource+typed-interface+test+audit+release+maintainability requirements remain fully binding and cannot be waived by the size exclusion;DIRECTORY:permission-core manages identity+owner+scope+exception lifecycle;VALUES:codex_parameter_registry only for scopes where limits apply.
